az_homestead_the.name: Homestead, The
az_homestead_the.note: Described as a winter limestone area, 3-season, end of season around May 5; no source names a month window.

ny_trapps_bouldering.name: Trapps Bouldering
ny_trapps_bouldering.note: Gunks: MP names Sep-Oct prime; spring and fall best; outfitter says season Apr to mid-Nov; summer hot and humid.

ut_eastern_reef_area_aka_the_sandstone_a.name: Eastern Reef Area.. AKA The Sandstone Alps
ut_eastern_reef_area_aka_the_sandstone_a.note: Only general Swell hiking guidance (winter, fall); no climbing months named.

tx_reimer_s_ranch_north_shore.name: Reimer's Ranch North Shore
tx_reimer_s_ranch_north_shore.note: Access Fund, SummitPost and ClimbingAway all say year-round (summer hot, early mornings; North Shore faces NW so shaded).

or_phone_home_boulders.name: Phone Home Boulders
or_phone_home_boulders.note: No season source for this boulder area.

bc_mamquam_fsr.name: Mamquam FSR
bc_mamquam_fsr.note: Squamish-wide sources: Apr-Sep season, May-Jun shoulder, late Jul-early Sep driest; winter rain Nov-Mar. Not Mamquam-specific.

md_harper_s_ferry.name: Harper's Ferry
md_harper_s_ferry.note: Spring and fall only as words (MP: early spring to late fall); no months named.

nm_white_rock.name: White Rock
nm_white_rock.note: MP says year-round, Overlook unclimbable in winter per local club; sources conflict, no months.

az_equestrian_area_closures_in_effect.name: Equestrian Area (Closures in Effect)
az_equestrian_area_closures_in_effect.note: Only generic park/hiking guidance and heat warnings; no climbing months.

wy_ten_sleep_canyon.name: Ten Sleep Canyon
wy_ten_sleep_canyon.note: May/June wonderful, crowds Memorial Day to Labor Day, Jul-Aug hot but shaded, Sep/Oct great; winter snow.

bc_chek.name: Chek
bc_chek.note: Star Chek guided season May-Oct; Squamish guide: May-Jun shoulder, Sep-Oct often best, Nov-Mar wet.

nh_sundown_bouldering.name: Sundown Bouldering
nh_sundown_bouldering.note: Regional guides name May, Jun, Sep, Oct but only from one publisher; nothing Sundown-specific.

al_hospital_boulders.name: Hospital Boulders
al_hospital_boulders.note: No source for this area; Chattanooga sandstone proxy (Nov-Mar) not confirmed for it.

ca_suicide_rock_2.name: Suicide Rock
ca_suicide_rock_2.note: SummitPost optimum season May-Oct; another guide mid-late spring to mid-late fall; cooler in summer shade.

ca_tuolumne_meadows.name: Tuolumne Meadows
ca_tuolumne_meadows.note: Season June-September (Tioga Rd opens late May/June, shuttle Jun-Sep); some say May to mid-fall, shared core Jun-Sep.

co_sailing_hawks.name: Sailing Hawks
co_sailing_hawks.note: Spring and fall words only; no months named.

az_6_mid_mountain.name: Mid-Mountain
az_6_mid_mountain.note: Only year-round claim for the mountain; nothing on the mid-elevation crags.

co_alderfer_three_sisters_park.name: Alderfer/Three Sisters Park
co_alderfer_three_sisters_park.note: Spring and autumn words only; no months named.

nv_kraft_boulders.name: Kraft Boulders
nv_kraft_boulders.note: Red Rocks: Oct to early April best; prime Nov-Mar; summer unbearable.

ut_right_fork.name: Right Fork
ut_right_fork.note: Maple Canyon sources: May into fall; Mar-Nov, popular Apr-Jun and Sep-Oct; snow blocks road to May, campground closes mid-Oct.
